label: copy-phase steps of length-3 sequences
explanation: Active only in the copy phase, almost entirely in L=3 sequences (93% of activation mass): steps t=4 (input orig(0), outputting orig(1)) and t=5 (input orig(1), outputting the last token orig(2)); t=5 carries more mass (~59%) and the top activations. A weak tail fires at t=6 of L=4 (recall_idx 2, ~6% mass) and rarely in L=9 late steps. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, or at the first copy step after <DEL>. Within L=3 it fires on only ~54% of eligible steps; which ones depends weakly on tokens (slightly more with letters and no digits, stronger with q/p/k/b), but no simple token rule improved precision. Raw magnitudes are tiny (max 0.002 above threshold).

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=6: p, k, r, a; t=12: k, r, a, v; t=4: b, q, k, a) and the previous input (most: z, q, b, c, j, 1; least: m, i, x, h); timing cues that raise it most: L=3, L=3 & t=4, L=3 & t=5.
